description.from: What the site satirises and its limits: public figures only, no private people, no victims of tragedies, no invented crimes, never reuse a source's wording or pictures. Saved with `papyrus sections doctrine set`.
description.to: What the site satirises and its limits: real public figures only, no private people, no victims of tragedies, no invented crimes attributed to real people, fictional people allowed when plainly fictional, a source's wording or pictures never reused. A piece may start from a real event or be wholly invented (Ryan, 2026-11-15). Saved with `papyrus sections doctrine set`.
